rendered: Energy density: the review says LIB energy density has risen since commercial debut, from 150 to 250 Wh kg^− 1[1] (the earlier starting point in the review's text). Battery cost: it has steadily fallen, from over $1000 kWh^− 1 in 2008[2] to around $130 kWh^− 1 in 2020[3] (see Fig. 11[4]). The review summarises the cost decline over the DOE programme as to reduce LIB cost by nearly eightfold[5]. The factors are therefore the energy density gain shown in the measured range above and a cost drop of roughly eightfold, from above $1000/kWh to around $130/kWh.
